title: บันทึกการขึ้นและหลุดของฟันลูก และการตรวจฟันโดยทันตบุคลากร

editorial.author: Claude Code (AI draft) for PMH developer
reviewNotes: Narration derived only from lesson MCH68-DENT-004 v0.1.0; no new content.
Thai-speaking reviewer: check pronunciation of 'ทันตบุคลากร', 'ดัชนีคราบจุลินทรีย์', the tooth letters spoken as 'เอ ถึง อี', and the page numbers 'หกสิบสาม' / 'หกสิบสี่'.
Curriculum videoTreatment for this lesson is 'none – interactive only'; this script was written on request. PMH to decide whether the video is produced.

Lesson note: the Plaque Index scoring (Mombelli 0-3), the p65 charting box and number grid are not explained; item 2 only says dental staff examine and record it and parents do not score it themselves (derived from the p65 title 'โดยทันตบุคลากร').
Lesson note: the reason for bringing the book (item 4: so dental staff can record the check on page 63) is derived from the p65 title and p2; the handbook does not say it in a sentence.

Lesson note: reading the tooth map (item 6) is derived from the p66 diagram. The handbook does not say whether ขวา/ซ้าย is the child's right/left; the video tells families to follow the words in the picture and does not explain orientation. Dentist to confirm.
Lesson note: 'จดเมื่อเห็นฟันซี่นั้นขึ้น / หลุด' (item 8) is how the p66 columns are read; no eruption or loss ages are given (PMH CLARIFICATION: typical eruption ages are not in the handbook).

Not used in the video: toothpaste amounts and fluoride strengths (FOR DENTIST REVIEW in DENT-001), the 'เฝ้าดูฟัน 6 ขวบปีแรก' age-by-age care (covered by V-DENT-001), the plastic-straw plaque check, the app privacy line, and the family note.
